culprit_citations.quoted_text: ONBE, Inc. | Initial Term Loan | 1M SOFR + 5.50% | Interest Rate 10.35% | Initial Acquisition Date 7/25/2024 | Maturity Date 7/25/2031

findings.detail: The extracted maturity_date is 2024-07-25, but the source row shows 7/25/2024 as initial acquisition date and 7/25/2031 as maturity date.

rationale: X10 flags the stored maturity_date 2024-07-25 as before the 2024-09-30 report date. The raw SOI row for ONBE, Inc. separates initial acquisition date 7/25/2024 from maturity date 7/25/2031, so the stored maturity_date copied the wrong date cell.
